stateMachine.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    S0 : S0: 未创建 (初始)
    S1 : S1: 已创建
    S2 : S2: 已支付
    S3 : S3: 备餐中
    S4 : S4: 已出餐
    S5 : S5: 配送中
    S6 : S6: 已送达 (终态)
    S7 : S7: 已取消 (终态)
    S0 --> S1 : create
    S1 --> S2 : pay_success
    S2 --> S3 : accept[accept_within_deadline]
    S3 --> S4 : finish_preparing
    S4 --> S5 : assign_rider[rider_available && rider_in_flight_orders < 10]
    S4 --> S7 : auto_cancel_no_rider[!(rider_available && rider_in_flight_orders < 10)]
    S5 --> S6 : confirm_delivery
    S1 --> S7 : cancel
    S2 --> S7 : cancel
    S2 --> S7 : auto_cancel_accept_timeout[accept_timeout]
    S5 --> S7 : auto_cancel_delivery_timeout[delivery_timeout]
    S2 --> S7 : reject_by_merchant
